candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record explicitly shows no malignancy on CT of chest/abdomen/pelvis, no lymphadenopathy, and negative endoscopy/colonoscopy, ruling out the paraneoplastic context required for paraneoplastic pemphigus. The immunoblot positivity for envoplakin (210 kDa) and periplakin (190 kDa) with negative DIF and all other autoantibody assays fits antiplakin dermatosis specifically. Paraneoplastic pemphigus shares the same autoantibody targets but is an incompatible subtype because it mandates an underlying neoplasm, which is absent here.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Paraneoplastic pemphigus is a specific subtype requiring an underlying neoplasm; antiplakin dermatosis is a distinct entity defined by antiplakin autoantibodies without neoplastic association

case_quality_flags: Antiplakin dermatosis is a rare, recently characterized entity; the absence of neoplasm is a critical distinguishing feature from paraneoplastic pemphigus despite shared autoantibody profile
